record.bible_text: Furthermore Elihu<WH0453> answered<WH06030><WTH8799> and said<WH0559><WTH8799>,
Hear<WH08085><WTH8798> my words<WH04405>, O ye wise<WH02450> <FI>men<Fi> ; and give ear<WH0238><WTH8685> unto me, ye that have knowledge<WH03045><WTH8802>.
For the ear<WH0241> trieth<WH0974><WTH8799> words<WH04405>, as the mouth<WH02441> tasteth<WH02938><WTH8799> meat<WH0398><WTH8800>. <RF>mouth: Heb. palate<Rf>
Let us choose<WH0977><WTH8799> to us judgment<WH04941>: let us know<WH03045><WTH8799> among ourselves what <FI>is<Fi> good<WH02896>.
For Job<WH0347> hath said<WH0559><WTH8804>, I am righteous<WH06663><WTH8804>: and God<WH0410> hath taken away<WH05493><WTH8689> my judgment<WH04941>.
Should I lie<WH03576><WTH8762> against my right<WH04941>? my wound<WH02671> <FI>is<Fi> incurable<WH0605><WTH8803> without transgression<WH06588>. <RF>my wound: Heb. mine arrow<Rf>
What man<WH01397> <FI>is<Fi> like Job<WH0347>, <FI>who<Fi> drinketh up<WH08354><WTH8799> scorning<WH03933> like water<WH04325>?
Which goeth<WH0732><WTH8804> in company<WH02274> with the workers<WH06466><WTH8802> of iniquity<WH0205>, and walketh<WH03212><WTH8800> with wicked<WH07562> men<WH0582>.
For he hath said<WH0559><WTH8804>, It profiteth<WH05532><WTH8799> a man<WH01397> nothing that he should delight<WH07521><WTH8800> himself with God<WH0430>.<CM>

Therefore hearken<WH08085><WTH8798> unto me, ye men<WH0582> of understanding<WH03824>: far be it<WH02486> from God<WH0410>, <FI>that he should do<Fi> wickedness<WH07562>; and <FI>from<Fi> the Almighty<WH07706>, <FI>that he should commit<Fi>  iniquity<WH05766>. <RF>men...: Heb. men of heart<Rf>
For the work<WH06467> of a man<WH0120> shall he render<WH07999><WTH8762> unto him, and cause every man<WH0376> to find<WH04672><WTH8686> according to <FI>his<Fi> ways<WH0734>.
Yea, surely<WH0551> God<WH0410> will not do wickedly<WH07561><WTH8686>, neither will the Almighty<WH07706> pervert<WH05791><WTH8762> judgment<WH04941>.
Who hath given him a charge<WH06485><WTH8804> over the earth<WH0776>? or who hath disposed<WH07760><WTH8804> the whole world<WH08398>? <RF>the whole: Heb. all of it?<Rf>
If he set<WH07760><WTH8799> his heart<WH03820> upon man, <FI>if<Fi> he gather<WH0622><WTH8799> unto himself his spirit<WH07307> and his breath<WH05397>; <RF>man: Heb. him<Rf>
All flesh<WH01320> shall perish<WH01478><WTH8799> together<WH03162>, and man<WH0120> shall turn again<WH07725><WTH8799> unto dust<WH06083>.<CM>
If now <FI>thou hast<Fi> understanding<WH0998>, hear<WH08085><WTH8798> this: hearken<WH0238><WTH8685> to the voice<WH06963> of my words<WH04405>.
Shall even he that hateth<WH08130><WTH8802> right<WH04941> govern<WH02280><WTH8799>? and wilt thou condemn<WH07561><WTH8686> him that is most<WH03524> just<WH06662>? <RF>govern: Heb. bind?<Rf>
<FI> Is it fit<Fi> to say<WH0559><WTH8800> to a king<WH04428>, <FI>Thou art<Fi> wicked<WH01100>? <FI>and<Fi> to princes<WH05081>, <FI>Ye are<Fi> ungodly<WH07563>?

<FI> How much less to him<Fi> that accepteth<WH05375><WTH8804> not the persons<WH06440> of princes<WH08269>, nor regardeth<WH05234><WTH8765> the rich<WH07771> more than<WH06440> the poor<WH01800>? for they all <FI>are<Fi> the work<WH04639> of his hands<WH03027>.

In a moment<WH07281> shall they die<WH04191><WTH8799>, and the people<WH05971> shall be troubled<WH01607><WTH8792> at midnight<WH02676><WH03915>, and pass away<WH05674><WTH8799>: and the mighty<WH047> shall be taken away<WH05493><WTH8686> without hand<WH03027>. <RF>the mighty...: Heb. they shall take away the mighty<Rf>
For his eyes<WH05869> <FI>are<Fi> upon the ways<WH01870> of man<WH0376>, and he seeth<WH07200><WTH8799> all his goings<WH06806>.
<FI> There is<Fi> no darkness<WH02822>, nor shadow of death<WH06757>, where the workers<WH06466><WTH8802> of iniquity<WH0205> may hide<WH05641><WTH8736> themselves.
For he will not lay<WH07760><WTH8799> upon man<WH0376> more <FI>than right<Fi> ; that he should enter<WH01980><WTH8800> into judgment<WH04941> with God<WH0410>. <RF>enter: Heb. go<Rf>
He shall break in pieces<WH07489><WTH8799> mighty men<WH03524> without number<WH02714>, and set<WH05975><WTH8686> others<WH0312> in their stead. <RF>number: Heb. searching out<Rf>

Therefore he knoweth<WH05234><WTH8686> their works<WH04566>, and he overturneth<WH02015><WTH8804> <FI>them<Fi> in the night<WH03915>, so that they are destroyed<WH01792><WTH8691>. <RF>destroyed: Heb. crushed<Rf>
He striketh<WH05606><WTH8804> them as<WH08478> wicked men<WH07563> in the open<WH04725> sight<WH07200><WTH8802> of others; <RF>open...: Heb. place of beholders<Rf>
Because they turned back<WH05493><WTH8804> from him<WH0310>, and would not consider<WH07919><WTH8689> any of his ways<WH01870>: <RF>him: Heb. after him<Rf>
So that they cause the cry<WH06818> of the poor<WH01800> to come<WH0935><WTH8687> unto him, and he heareth<WH08085><WTH8799> the cry<WH06818> of the afflicted<WH06041>.

When he giveth quietness<WH08252><WTH8686>, who then can make trouble<WH07561><WTH8686>? and when he hideth<WH05641><WTH8686> <FI>his<Fi> face<WH06440>, who then can behold<WH07789><WTH8799> him? whether <FI>it be done<Fi> against a nation<WH01471>, or against a man<WH0120> only<WH03162>:
That the hypocrite<WH0120><WH02611> reign<WH04427><WTH8800> not, lest the people<WH05971> be ensnared<WH04170>.<CM>
Surely it is meet to be said<WH0559><WTH8736> unto God<WH0410>, I have borne<WH05375><WTH8804> <FI>chastisement<Fi> , I will not offend<WH02254><WTH8799> <FI>any more<Fi> :
<FI> That which<Fi> I see<WH02372><WTH8799> not<WH01107> teach<WH03384><WTH8685> thou me: if I have done<WH06466><WTH8804> iniquity<WH05766>, I will do<WH03254><WTH8686> no more.

<FI> Should it be<Fi> according to thy mind? he will recompense<WH07999><WTH8762> it, whether thou refuse<WH03588><WH03988><WTH8804>, or whether thou choose<WH0977><WTH8799>; and not I: therefore speak<WH01696><WTH8761> what thou knowest<WH03045><WTH8804>. <RF>according...: Heb. from with thee?<Rf>
Let men<WH0582> of understanding<WH03824> tell<WH0559><WTH8799> me, and let a wise<WH02450> man<WH01397> hearken<WH08085><WTH8802> unto me. <RF>of...: Heb. of heart<Rf>
Job<WH0347> hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8762> without knowledge<WH01847>, and his words<WH01697> <FI>were<Fi> without wisdom<WH07919><WTH8687>.

My desire<WH015><WTH8676><WH01> <FI>is that<Fi> Job<WH0347> may be tried<WH0974><WTH8735> unto the end<WH05331> because of <FI>his<Fi> answers<WH08666> for wicked<WH0205> men<WH0582>. <RF>My...: or, My father, let Job be tried<Rf>

For he addeth<WH03254><WTH8686> rebellion<WH06588> unto his sin<WH02403>, he clappeth<WH05606><WTH8799> <FI>his hands<Fi> among us, and multiplieth<WH07235><WTH8686> his words<WH0561> against God<WH0410>.<CM>
